title: Replying to @juaanfrraa That and more! #theatre #musicaltheatre #broa...
transcript: It's honestly kinda crazy that we have three big musical revivals coming to New York this fall, and they are literally three of my favorite musicals of all time. And this video is part two of several talking about shows I'm looking forward to this fall. This person asked about the Fantasticks and as you can see, I'm a bit of a fan. For those who don't know, the Fantasticks, it holds the record for the longest running musical in the world. It was off Broadway for over 40 years, and then it came back off Broadway for, I think, another 11 years. But this revival will be the first time the show has ever played on Broadway, and it's been reimagined to be about a romance between two boys instead of a boy and a girl. I'm excited to see this show in any form again, but I am also very curious to see how this revision plays. Then, of course, we have the encores run of in the Heights. In the Heights is maybe my second favorite musical of all time, and this revival is gonna be from the director of Mexodus, so I'm just ridiculously pumped for this. And finally we have the off Broadway revival of Spring Awakening, another old favorite of mine going way back to my youth. I saw the original production of this on tour when I was 12 years old, sitting right next to my mom. That was an interesting experience. But anyway, This revival is gonna be directed by Danya Taymor, who did the outsiders, and John Procter Is The villain. I was listening to the cast album last year for the first time in a while and it struck me just how well this score has held up. It is honestly just no skips. Banger after banger. I think I even made a video saying like, hey, are the kids still listening to Spring Awakening these days? Because if not, someone needs to turn the back on to it.
